messages:
maria (Finance): Heads up — customer Trivium reported invoice INV-2026-0042 shows a $0.02 overcharge compared to the portal. Looks like a stray lineitem 'one-time adjustment'. @jonathan can you take a look? Ticket #123456
jonathan (Billing Eng): On it. Can you paste the exported invoice JSON or a pdf snippet?
maria (Finance): Here’s the lines pasted from the export:
```
- compute: $123.45
- reserved discount: -$12.34
- one-time adjustment: $0.02 (qty: 1, unit_price: $0.02)
- total: $111.13
```
jonathan (Billing Eng): Hmm — could be a rounding/invert sign bug during ingest or CSV processing. Re-running export: `python billing/export_invoice.py --id INV-2026-0042 --env prod`
billing-bot: Export job started for INV-2026-0042 (run_id: r-824) — ETA ~15s
jonathan (Billing Eng): I dug into reconciliation. There's an orphan adjustment record in invoice_line_items with source='manual_import' and amount_cents=2 but no owner tag. Looks like it was created by the vendor CSV ingest job on 2026-03-14 03:12 UTC. Repro query: `SELECT * FROM invoice_line_items WHERE invoice_id='INV-2026-0042' AND amount_cents<>0`
laura (Customer Ops): @maria any chance the customer uploaded something that could've triggered this? I see an upload named 'trivium-corrections.csv' on Mar 14.
maria (Finance): Yup that upload exists — support notes indicate they attempted a correction to reserved discount. Seems our ingest created a positive adjustment instead of a negative correction.
jonathan (Billing Eng): Root cause: ingest job flips sign when 'correction' flag is present. I'll open a PR and prepare a hotfix for billing-processor. For immediate fix I will: 1) rollback the orphan line (`DELETE FROM invoice_line_items WHERE id='li-9982'`) 2) re-run export 3) generate credit note. @laura can you handle customer communication?
laura (Customer Ops): Got it — I'll draft the credit note and email Trivium, cc finance@redwood.com.
billing-bot: Export job r-824 finished: checksum mismatch resolved. New pdf generated: s3://invoices/2026/INV-2026-0042-v2.pdf
maria (Finance): Thanks all. I'll log a short postmortem and add an alert on manual-import jobs to block sign flips. @jonathan please add me to the PR review. :thumbsup:
